import os
import pathlib
import re
lines = (pathlib.Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "lsf-clippy.log").read_text().splitlines()
errors = [" ".join(lines[i:i + 4]) for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^error(?:\[.*?\])?:", line)]

python3 -B tools/run_publication_retention_signed.py --cli "${PWD}/target/debug/latent" --node "${PWD}/target/debug/latentd" --fixture-root "${fixture_root}/publication-inputs" --source-commit "${GITHUB_SHA}" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/phase2-gate/publication-retention-signed-receipt.json"

# these same runtime-only copies, never the unstripped originals.

for binary in latent latentd; do

done

LSF_GATE_FIXTURE_ROOT="${fixture_root}" python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
binaries = pathlib.Path(os.environ["LSF_GATE_FIXTURE_ROOT"]) / "resource-bin"
def digest(path):
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        return "sha256:" + hashlib.file_digest(source, "sha256").hexdigest()
identity = {
    "schemaVersion": "latent.phase2.resource-build.v1",
    "sourceRevision": os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"],
    "cargoLockSha256": digest(root / "Cargo.lock"),
    "cliSha256": digest(binaries / "latent"),
    "nodeSha256": digest(binaries / "latentd"),
    "rustcVersion": subprocess.check_output(["rustc", "--version"], text=True).strip(),
    "buildProfile": "debug",
}
(pathlib.Path(os.environ["LSF_GATE_FIXTURE_ROOT"]) / "build.json").write_text(json.dumps(identity))
PY
